_readme: Copy to appsettings.Production.json on ATWK-WEB-1 (the shared platform web server) and fill in. SQL: ATWK-SQL-1 (SQL Server 2025, the shared platform SQL Server), own database ITAM_Production. No passwords: SQL Server, AD and the mail relay accept the IIS application pool identity. Production: ITAM_Production (owner decision, 22 October 2026); keep Mail.Enabled false or a TestRecipient until the owner approves real email.

Directory.Host: <a domain controller name, for example dc01.altawkilat.com>

Mail.TestRecipient: <one test mailbox during the test phase; empty to send to the real people>
